descriptors.description: Metadata describing an entity or shared processing inputs, with named References to representations

references.name: references
references.description: Named References. The map can be empty; names do not imply a class or message role

class.name: class
class.description: Standard representation class or absolute URI class identifier

url.name: url
url.description: Absolute fragment-free retrieval URL, used without modification

planurl.name: planurl
planurl.description: Optional projection-plan provenance for a resolved TD or TM; not a bundle input

entityid.name: entityid
entityid.description: Absolute fragment-free identity URI of the primary entity; not a retrieval instruction

entitytype.name: entitytype
entitytype.description: Absolute fragment-free type URI from an agreed vocabulary; requires entityid

messageref.name: messageref
messageref.description: Exact name of an existing message Reference

schemaref.name: schemaref
schemaref.description: Exact name of an existing schema Reference selected as the Descriptor's payload schema
